description: The team consists of a close friend group, that decided to try something new. We hope that through study, trial and error we will finish this this project and hopefully get experience and inspiration to join more opportunities like this one, the NASA Space Apps.
summary: The work on skyTrace has led us to the powerful website we have now. Using Aladin Lite, we offer the user the ability to take a look at the beauty of the universe from the perspective of DSS2, 2MASS, ALLWISE. This allows the user to find a spot in the space that interests them, and to showcase the differences in time the website turns to the archive that lies in the very heart of our project, Infared Science Archive (IRSA). From the Spectro-Photometer for the History of the Universe, Epoch of Reionization, and Ices Explorer (SPHEREx) satellite we query all of the available information regarding the coordinates requested by the user and create the pictures to build a timeline of observations. This way the user can study the timeline and find differences using our built in comparing method. It's a great oportunity for any schooler/student interested in astronomy to experience how the astronomers of the past felt discovering new objects in the sky. A person with enough knowledge could even use our project as a tool to make discoveries of their own.
details: From the requested coordinates our project queries the URLs of all the FITS-files that include that coordinate.
